275.       logger.error({
276.         message: 'Error while deleting post',
277.         meta: {
278.           function: 'deletePost',
279.         },
280.         error,
281.       })
282.       return res.status(500).json({ message: 'Server Error' })
283.     }
284.   }
285. 
286.   /**
287.    * Update a post
288.    * @param Post Post to be updated
289.    * @return 200 if successful
290.    * @return 400 if title and description is too short or long
291.    * @return 401 if user is not logged in
292.    * @return 403 if user does not have permission to delete post
293.    * @return 500 if database error
294.    */
295.   updatePost: RequestHandler<
296.     { id: string },
297.     Message,
298.     UpdatePostRequestDto,
299.     unknown
300.   > = async (req, res) => {
301.     const postId = req.params.id
302.     try {
303.       const userId = await this.authService.getUserIdFromToken(
304.         req.header('x-auth-token') ?? '',
305.       )
306.       if (!userId) {
307.         return res
308.           .status(401)
309.           .json({ message: 'You must be logged in to update posts.' })
310.       }
311.       const hasPermission = await this.authService.hasPermissionToAnswer(
312.         userId,
313.         postId,
314.       )
315.       if (!hasPermission) {
316.         return res
317.           .status(403)
318.           .json({ message: 'You do not have permission to update this post.' })
319.       }
320.     } catch (error) {
321.       logger.error({
322.         message: 'Error while determining permissions to update post',
323.         meta: {
324.           function: 'updatePost',
325.         },
326.         error,
327.       })
328.       return res
329.         .status(500)
330.         .json({ message: 'Something went wrong, please try again.' })
331.     }
332.     const errors = validationResult(req as Request)
333.     if (!errors.isEmpty()) {
334.       return res.status(400).json({ message: errors.array()[0].msg })
335.     }
336.     // Update post in database
337.     try {
338.       const updated = await this.postService.updatePost({
339.         title: req.body.title,
340.         description: req.body.description ?? '',
341.         tagname: req.body.tagname,
342.         id: postId,
343.       })
344. 
345.       if (!updated) {
346.         return res.status(500).json({ message: 'Answer failed to update' })
347.       }
348.       return res.status(200).json({ message: 'Answer updated' })
349.     } catch (err) {
350.       return res.status(500).json({ message: 'Answer failed to update' })
351.     }
352.   }
353. }

2. import { format } from 'winston'
3. 
4. /**
5.  * A custom formatter for winston. Transforms winston's info object into a
6.  * string representation, mainly used for console logging.
7.  */
8. export const formatLogMessage = format.printf((info) => {
9.   // Handle multiple arguments passed into logger
10.   // e.g. logger.info('param1', 'param2')
11.   // The second parameter onwards will be passed into the `splat` key and
12.   // require formatting (because that is just how the library is written).
13.   const splatSymbol = Symbol.for('splat') as unknown as string
14.   const splatArgs = info[splatSymbol] || []
15.   const rest = splatArgs
16.     .map((data: unknown) => formatWithInspect(data))
17.     .join(' ')
18.   return `${info.timestamp} ${info.level} [${info.label}]: ${formatWithInspect(
19.     info.message,
20.   )}\t${rest}`
21. })
22. 
23. const isPrimitive = (val: unknown): boolean => {
24.   return val === null || (typeof val !== 'object' && typeof val !== 'function')
25. }
26. 
27. /**
28.  * Formats a log message for readability.
29.  * Adapted from
30.  * https://github.com/winstonjs/winston/issues/1427#issuecomment-583199496
31.  */
32. const formatWithInspect = (val: unknown): string => {
33.   // We have a custom method for printing errors, so ignore errors here
34.   if (val instanceof Error) {
35.     return ''
36.   }
37.   const formattedVal =
38.     typeof val === 'string' ? val : inspect(val, { depth: null, colors: true })
39. 
40.   return isPrimitive(val) ? formattedVal : `\n${formattedVal}`
41. }
